title: Check-In Inspection Standard: Charges at Return of a Courtesy Transportation Agreements Loaner
content:
Inspection and charging standard of the check-in lane for loaners returned under the Courtesy Transportation Agreements. At check-in the loaner's odometer reading and fuel level are recorded and the agreement passes from out status to returned status. Every rate, allowance and fee named below is the returning program's own figure.

## Standard

**A. Mileage.** At return the miles driven, being the odometer reading at return less the odometer reading at issue, are compared with the program's mileage allowance per day multiplied by the days of the agreement, courtesy and charged days alike. Miles above the allowance plus the program's free buffer miles are charged at the program's excess mileage rate each. The excess mileage charge is rounded to the cent and is never below zero.

**B. Fuel.** Fuel returned below the issue level is charged the program's fuel charge per eighth for each eighth of a tank short, plus the program's refueling service fee once. The per-eighth amount is rounded to the cent.

**C. Late return.** A loaner returned after the due date plus the program's grace days, counted in calendar days, is charged the program's late return fee for each further day, for at most the program's most late days charged.

**D. Condition fees.** The cleaning fee, the smoking fee and the pet hair fee apply only when the check-in inspection records the condition. Pets and smoking are not allowed in a loaner where the program does not allow pets or smoking.

**E. Return location.** A loaner returned to another group store, where the program does not require same-store return, is charged the program's other-store return fee. Where the program requires same-store return, the loaner must come back to the issuing store.

**F. After-hours drop.** Where the program allows after-hours return, a loaner dropped after hours is returned on the date it is checked in the next business morning. Where the program does not allow it, an after-hours drop counts as returned only at check-in during opening hours.

**G. One posting per charge.** Each charge code is posted once per agreement.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

The allowance of 120 miles per day, the buffer of 20 miles, the rate of 0.30 per mile, the fuel figures and the day numbers below are invented for illustration and are not program figures.

**Mileage, 3-day agreement** (allowance 120 miles per day across all 3 days, so 360 miles, plus a 20-mile buffer, so 380 miles free):

| Miles driven | Miles charged | Excess mileage charge |
|---|---|---|
| 370 | 0 | none |
| 380 | 0 | none |
| 381 | 1 | 0.30 |
| 450 | 70 | 21.00 |

**Fuel**, a hypothetical charge of 6.00 per eighth and a service fee of 9.00: issued at 6 eighths and returned at 3 eighths, the loaner is 3 eighths short, so 18.00 plus the 9.00 fee, 27.00 in all. Returned at 6 eighths or above, there is no fuel charge and no service fee.

**Late return**, a hypothetical due date of day 10, one grace day, a late fee of 30.00 per day and at most 4 late days:

| Returned on | Days beyond due date plus grace | Late days charged | Late return charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 10 | 0 | 0 | none |
| Day 11 | 0 | 0 | none |
| Day 12 | 1 | 1 | 30.00 |
| Day 18 | 7 | 4 | 120.00 |

## Points of judgement

- Clause D is a closed condition: with no condition recorded by the check-in inspection, the cleaning, smoking and pet hair fees do not apply.
- Under clause F, the return date of an after-hours drop is the check-in date, not the evening the keys were left.
- Under clause G, a late return charge, for example, appears once on an agreement however many late days it covers.
